text_en: Some time after this, the cupbearer of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord the king of Egypt.
text_cn: 这些事以后，埃及王的司酒和司厨得罪了他们的主人埃及王。

text_en: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,
text_cn: 法郎于是对那两个内臣，司酒长和司厨长发了怒，

text_en: and he put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the prison where Joseph was confined.
text_cn: 将他们囚在卫队长府内的拘留所内，若瑟被囚禁的地方。

text_en: The captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he waited on them; and they continued for some time in custody.
text_cn: 卫队长将他们交给若瑟，若瑟就照管他们。他们在拘留所内过了一些时日，

text_en: One night they both dreamed—the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were confined in the prison—each his own dream, and each dream with its own meaning.
text_cn: 那两个被囚在狱里的埃及王的司酒和司厨，在同一夜里，各作了一梦；每人的梦都有它的意义。

text_en: When Joseph came to them in the morning, he saw that they were troubled.
text_cn: 早晨若瑟到了他们那里，见他们面有忧色，

text_en: So he asked Pharaoh’s officers, who were with him in custody in his master’s house, “Why are your faces downcast today? ”
text_cn: 便问那与他同在自己主人府中监狱里的法郎内臣说：“为什么你们今天面带忧色？”

text_en: They said to him, “We have had dreams, and there is no one to interpret them. ” And Joseph said to them, “Do not interpretations belong to God? Please tell them to me. ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“我们各作了一梦，没有人能够解释。”若瑟对他们说：“解梦不是天主的事吗？请你们讲给我听！”

text_en: So the chief cupbearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream there was a vine before me,
text_cn: 司酒长就将自己的梦讲给若瑟听，对他说：“我梦见在我前面有株葡萄树。

text_en: and on the vine there were three branches. As soon as it budded, its blossoms came out and the clusters ripened into grapes.
text_cn: 树上有三根枝子，刚发芽，就生出了花朵，花朵结了熟葡萄。

text_en: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and placed the cup in Pharaoh’s hand. ”
text_cn: 我手拿着法郎的杯，将葡萄挤在法郎的杯中，将杯递在法郎的手内。”

text_en: Then Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days;
text_cn: 若瑟对他说：“这梦的意义就是：三根枝子是指的三天。

text_en: within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your office; and you shall place Pharaoh’s cup in his hand, just as you used to do when you were his cupbearer.
text_cn: 三天以内，法郎要高举你，恢复你的职位；你仍将杯放在法郎的手中，像先前作他司酒时一样；

text_en: But remember me when it is well with you; please do me the kindness to make mention of me to Pharaoh, and so get me out of this place.
text_cn: 但是，当你得志时，请你记得我，望你对我施恩，为我告诉法郎，救我出离这监牢；

text_en: For in fact I was stolen out of the land of the Hebrews; and here also I have done nothing that they should have put me into the dungeon. ”
text_cn: 因为我不但是由希伯来人地被拐来的，而且在这里我也没有做过什么使他们将我放在这地牢里的事。”

text_en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was favorable, he said to Joseph, “I also had a dream: there were three cake baskets on my head,
text_cn: 司厨长见他解得吉祥，便对若瑟说：“我也作了一梦，梦见在我的头上有三筐白饼。

text_en: and in the uppermost basket there were all sorts of baked food for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating it out of the basket on my head. ”
text_cn: 最上面的筐内，有为法郎预备的各种食物，有飞鸟来啄食我头上筐里的食物。”

text_en: And Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation: the three baskets are three days;
text_cn: 若瑟回答说：“这梦的意义就是：三筐是指的三天。

text_en: within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head—from you! —and hang you on a pole; and the birds will eat the flesh from you. ”
text_cn: 三天以内，法郎要高举你，将你悬在木架上，飞鸟要来啄食你的肉。”

text_en: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and lifted up the head of the chief cupbearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
text_cn: 第三天，适逢法郎的生日，法郎为群臣摆设了盛宴，在群臣中将司酒长和司厨长提出来，

text_en: He restored the chief cupbearer to his cupbearing, and he placed the cup in Pharaoh’s hand;
text_cn: 恢复了司酒长的司酒职，再将杯放在法郎手中；

text_en: but the chief baker he hanged, just as Joseph had interpreted to them.
text_cn: 至于司厨长，却被悬挂起来，正如若瑟对他们所解释的。

text_en: Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.
text_cn: 司酒长却没有记得若瑟，竟将他忘了。
